diff_summary: Refactored race-history domain into domain APIRouters in laps.py and race_archive.py using FastAPI dependency injection (get_race_db, get_race_telemetry, admin, current_user), preserved backward compatibility hooks and aliases, folded assembly glue in main.py, and maintained exact OpenAPI contracts and unique route registrations.

verification.command: APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/pytest -q backend/tests/test_contract_snapshot.py backend/tests/test_route_registration.py backend/tests/test_api.py -k "test_archive_provisional or test_historical_archive or test_simulation_keeps or test_demo_car_numbers or test_restarting_simulator" && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/mypy --strict backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff check backend/app && APP_ENV=local .venv/bin/ruff format --check backend/app
